module: Manager of the stunt zones of drift/Gymkhana mode. setStuntZones(zones) creates one object per zone by loading the submodule of the requested type (donut, driftThrough, hitPole, nearPole, in gameplay/drift/stuntZones/<type>); then, every frame, while the player is drifting, it calls detectStunt() on the available zones the player is in. When a zone is accomplished, it emits onAnyStuntZoneAccomplished, which this module relays to the stallingSystem and to a sub-hook (onDonutDriftAccomplished, onDriftThroughAccomplished, onHitPoleAccomplished, onNearPoleAccomplished) handled by gameplay_drift_scoring. Loaded by gameplay_drift_general in the inChallenge context; zones come from gameplay_drift_saveLoad.loadDriftData.
notes: Zone format: {type, pos = vec3, scl, rot = quat, cooldown, score?}. donut: scl = radius in m (number); driftThrough: scl = vec3 of half-dimensions and rot = quat; hitPole/nearPole: only pos (a "delineator" pole is spawned).
"Near" distance for the onNearStuntZoneFirst(stuntZone) hook: scl + 6 if scl is a number, max(scl.x, y, z) + 4 if it is a vec3, 6 otherwise; emitted only once per zone type (on-screen help).

If the zone has no score field, it is filled with scoreOptions.defaultPoints[type]; but the score actually awarded comes from gameplay_drift_scoring.getStuntZoneBasePoints(type) (the submodules do not use zoneData.score).
Zones are only evaluated if drift is neither paused nor frozen, and if the player has a vehicle (doesPlHaveVeh).
onSerialize calls clear(): spawned poles are removed before a Lua reload. onExtensionUnloaded does the same.
When the player stops drifting, the donuts' angle counter is reset to zero (onDriftStatusChanged).
increaseDecalPool uses a global variable decals that is not declared in this file: only call it if it exists elsewhere (it is not called in this file).
getDecalColor contains conditions like ((t * 100) or (100 - t * 100)) that are always true on the first operand: the second branch is never used.

setStuntZones.desc: Replaces all zones with the given list: clears the existing zones (clear), computes the "near" distance, the default score and the draw data, then instantiates each zone via require("gameplay/drift/stuntZones/<type>"). Ids are assigned from 1 to n.

zones.desc: List of {type, pos, scl, rot, cooldown, score}.

getStuntZones.desc: Returns the list of instantiated zone objects (each object has data = {id, zoneData, nearDist, drawData}, activeData and the type's methods).

clear.desc: Removes all zones (poles and markers included) and forgets the zone types already approached.

reset.desc: Calls reset() on each zone (cooldowns, counters, poles put back in place).

clearStuntZone.desc: INTERNAL: removes a zone by id (calls its clear if it exists, then removes it from the list). Used by destroyed poles.

increaseDecalPool.desc: Grows the global decal pool up to max elements (red arrow, fade 100 to 150). Depends on a global variable decals not defined here.

getDecalColor.desc: Chooses the color of a segment of a donut's circle: blue (filled portion), green (ready), red/white (during cooldown).

filledPerc.desc: Percentage of the turn already completed.

t.desc: Position of the segment on the circle, from 0 to 1.

getLineThickness.desc: Debug line thickness depending on distance to the camera (250 / distance).

getDrawLines.desc: TEST: indicates whether zone drawing is enabled ("Draw lines" imgui checkbox, true by default).

getDriftDebugInfo.desc: Returns {default=true, canBeChanged=true} for the drift debug window.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame: debug window, then (when not paused/frozen) for each available zone detects the approach (onNearStuntZoneFirst), calls detectStunt() if the player is drifting in the zone, then the zone's onUpdate and cooldown handling.

onDriftStatusChanged.desc: Hook: when the drift stops, resets the accumulated angle of donut zones to zero.

onAnyStuntZoneAccomplished.desc: Hook: a zone is accomplished; informs the stallingSystem (processStuntZone) then relays the requested sub-hook with its data.

onDriftDebugChanged.desc: Hook: re-enables zone drawing when debug changes.

onVehicleDestroyed.desc: Hook: relays a vehicle's destruction to the zones (destroyed poles remove themselves).

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Hook: removes all zones on unload.

onSerialize.desc: Hook: removes all zones before a Lua reload (returns no data).
